ننعدي (form VII)
# نَنْعَدِي (nanʕadī) /nan.ʕa.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَدَى (inʕadā)
# نَنْعَدِيَ (nanʕadiya) /nan.ʕa.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَدَى (inʕadā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
